def: to continue to live in common with, i.e. co-survive (literally or figuratively)

occurrences.text: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:
I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.
It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
